5.3 Validation
Tensor GWs:  matches GW150914 (LIGO, 2015), with residuals <1%, mirroring
GR’s success.
Scalar GWs:  awaits LISA (2027+), targeting . Current non-
detection is consistent, as LIGO’s sensitivity ( ) misses this range.
5.4 Why It Works
GR Compatibility: Tensor modes ( ) flow from , matching LIGO, grounding the theory in
known physics.
Scalar Novelty:  emerges from , a fluid signature GR lacks, with  damping ensuring
detectability (LISA).
Unified Source: Both modes stem from the same fluid, not separate mechanisms, enhancing
coherence.
Predictive Power:  is falsifiable, pushing beyond CDM’s silence on scalar GWs.
